name: document-metadata
instructions: Extract metadata about this document, not cited works. Distinguish publication dates, information cutoffs and reporting periods. Preserve unknowns. Never use filenames or capture timestamps as proof of publication. Keep publisher wording unless the document establishes its expansion.

fields.name: publisher
fields.prompt: The issuing organisation, supported by an imprint or statement of responsibility.

fields.name: publication_date
fields.prompt: Publication date of this document. Use only the supported year/month/day precision.

fields.name: information_cutoffs
fields.prompt: Explicit data cutoffs or as-of dates. Give the scope of each; do not infer a whole-document cutoff from a topic-specific one.

fields.name: reporting_periods
fields.prompt: Reporting periods with nullable start/end date objects and explicit scope.

fields.name: reference_numbers
fields.prompt: This document's report number, DOI or ISBN; retain exact identifier wording.

fields.name: keywords
fields.prompt: Up to eight concise topic suggestions. Do not treat suggestions as source facts.
